bills.title: Home Affairs Legislation Amendment (2025 Measures No. 1) Bill 2025

name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2025-09-03.239.1) *"that the bill may proceed without formalities.*" ### What does this motion need? According to the [parliamentary procedure handbook](https://www.aph.gov.au/About_Parliament/Senate/Practice_and_Procedure/aso/so113), the motion "*that the bill may proceed with formalities*": > *shall have the effect of suspending any requirements for stages of the passage of the bill or bills to take place on different days, for notice of motions for such stages, and for the printing and certification of the bill or bills during passage*
